name: MRR Bridge

name: Plan Mix & Seat Utilisation
note: A two-level squarified treemap of plans and accounts, recoloured through a three-stop color-mix(in oklch) ramp driven by per-tile utilisation variables; zooming into a plan and switching size between MRR and seats morph every tile on spring-eased geometry, arrow keys move spatially between tiles, and an @property integer counts the utilisation ring. Set --dbs-seats-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: NRR Cohort Triangle
note: A retention triangle whose cells mix a diverging oklch scale from a single --t variable, reveal and recolour in a diagonal wave staggered by row plus column, and light a pure-CSS crosshair through :has() on the hovered cell; pinned cohorts draw as curves against the MRR-weighted average, and the grid is a keyboard-navigable ARIA grid. Set --dbs-cohort-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Dunning Recovery Flow
note: A failed-payment river: the trunk narrows through each retry while recovered invoices peel down and pending ones peel up, every ribbon computed from invoice-level data and morphed with the CSS d property when the range, reason or unit changes; flow dashes pause off screen via IntersectionObserver, and Retry now settles invoices and rolls the totals. Set --dbs-dunning-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Trial Conversion Particle Funnel
note: Every particle is a trial that passes each gate at exactly the filtered stage conversion rate or falls away under gravity, drawn on one DPR-capped 2D canvas sized by ResizeObserver whose rAF loop IntersectionObserver and document.hidden pause, with an HTML stage strip as its accessible twin. Set --dbs-funnel-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Admin Console & Impersonation
